title: Department HODs, Faculty and Key Staff - KITCOEK
text:
KITCOEK DEPARTMENT WISE HEAD OF DEPARTMENT (HOD) LIST

This page lists all department heads (HOD) and key faculty at KIT's College of Engineering, Kolhapur (KITCOEK).

Department: Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
HOD Name: Dr. Lingaraj A. Hadimani
Established: 1999 | Intake: 180 | NBA: 2008, 2018, 2023

Department: CSE - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (CSE-AIML)
HOD Name: Dr. Uma P. Gurav
Established: 2021 | Intake: 120
Focus: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science

Department: Computer Science and Business Systems (CSBS)
HOD Name: Dr. Manjunath R. Hudagi
In collaboration with TCS (Tata Consultancy Services)

Department: Civil Engineering
HOD Name: Dr. Aditya K. Khebudkar
Established: 1983 (oldest) | Intake: 120 | NBA: 2005, 2008, 2018, 2020, 2023

Department: Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE)
HOD Name: Dr. Akash Anand
NBA Accredited | Focus: Environmental sustainability, smart cities

Department: Mechanical Engineering
HOD Name: Dr. Uday S. Bhapkar
Established: 2002 | Intake: 180 | M.Tech: Mechanical Engineering Design

Department: Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (E&TC)
NBA Accredited | M.Tech program available

Department: Electrical Engineering
HOD Name: Dr. Mir Khadim Aalam
Established: 2018 | Optional Honours: Electric Vehicle Technology

Department: Biotechnology Engineering
NBA Accredited | Established: 2002 | 750+ graduates
M.Tech: Biochemical Engineering | Recruiters: Pfizer, Amgen, Biocon, Dr. Reddy's

Department: Basic Sciences and Humanities (BSH)
HOD Name: Dr. A.M. Qureshi
Supports 1200+ FY B.Tech students across 16 divisions

Dean Examinations and Evaluation (Controller of Examinations): Mr. S.S. Kadam (NOT Dr. Manoj Yadav)
